caption: Content Policy Filter
description: The Content Policy Filter object describes the result of a content policy filter evaluation by an AI guardrail. Each filter assesses content against a specific category (e.g., hate speech, violence) and reports a confidence level and action taken.
name: content_policy_filter

action.description: The action taken by the content filter, normalized to the caption of the action_id value. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source.

action_id.description: The normalized action taken by the content filter.

1.caption: None
1.description: No action was taken. The content was allowed to pass through.

2.caption: Blocked
2.description: The content was blocked by the guardrail.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The action is not mapped. See the action attribute, which contains a data source specific value.

confidence.description: The confidence level of the filter detection, normalized to the caption of the confidence_id value. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source.

confidence_id.description: The normalized confidence level of the content filter detection.

1.caption: None
1.description: No confidence. The content was not detected as matching this filter category.

2.caption: Low
2.description: Low confidence that the content matches this filter category.

3.caption: Medium
3.description: Medium confidence that the content matches this filter category.

4.caption: High
4.description: High confidence that the content matches this filter category.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The confidence level is not mapped. See the confidence attribute, which contains a data source specific value.

type.description: The content filter type, normalized to the caption of the type_id value. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source.

type_id.description: The normalized content filter type identifier.

0.caption: Unknown
0.description: The content filter type is unknown.

5.caption: Misconduct
5.description: Content that describes or promotes misconduct.

6.caption: Prompt Attack
6.description: Content that contains a prompt injection or jailbreak attempt.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The content filter type is not mapped. See the type attribute, which contains a data source specific value.
